A '''sea skimmer''' was a type of [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] that could fly.<ref name="AAC" /> In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Ambush at Corellia]]'' to [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]]</ref> [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Belindi Kalenda]] set up a pair of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] in a [[Window/Legends|window]] of an unoccupied house on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to alert her to any activity outside the house down the street where [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was staying with her [[Solo family/Legends|family]]. The macrobinoculars were sensitive enough that they would go off if a sea skimmer flew past the window.<ref name="AAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The sea skimmer was mentioned in ''[[Ambush at Corellia]]'', the first novel in [[Star Wars: The Corellian Trilogy|''The Corellian Trilogy'']], written by [[Roger MacBride Allen]] and published in [[1995]].<ref name="AAC" />
